svg.title: pi-delegate: Claude briefs, pi does the work, your tests decide
svg.desc: Flow from you to Claude Code, to run.sh safety checks, to pi on any model, to your verify tests, with a retry back to pi and a short result back to Claude Code; below, a bar chart showing Claude's cost falling from $0.082 to $0.055 on multi-file tasks because the work moves to pi.
